items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: So I went to work with Jerome. Jerome Richardson. He had a little quartet and he was struggling

ctx.x: Or when a name came in and they wanted to augment the band. Maybe it was ’52, ’53. So I went to work with Jerome. Jerome Richardson. He had a little quartet and he was struggling so he did three or four nights maybe here or three or four nights there. So with Jerome we played a place called The Village in Richmond and we had George Morrow and Jerome and Cedrick Haywood on piano.
Well you and I have something in common then.
